evidence_kind: source trace checked against Android API contract; no physical reproduction
source_trace: CameraCapture.kt:90 passes CameraDevice::close to CameraStartup, and its callback does not override onClosed.
CameraCapture.kt:102 does the same for CameraCaptureSession.
CameraStartup.kt:31 registers close(value) as the complete destruction callback.
CameraResources.kt:81 invokes callbacks, then clears closing without an asynchronous device completion observation.
CameraRecovery.kt:22 calls resources.close; line 23 delays 250/500 ms; the next iteration reopens the same selected device.
LocalMediaRuns.kt:34 calls CameraCapture.run inside one worker. MediaWorkerService process retirement is outside those retries.
counterexample_schedule: Open first device and session; establish streaming.
Transport raises CameraTransportException while resources.checkActive succeeds.
Cleanup calls session.close, device.close and releases other resources. The original onClosed remains undelivered.
After the first 250 ms backoff, the next attempt calls openCamera with the same camera ID while original shutdown is unconfirmed.
required_regression: Withhold an identity-bound original close completion past the retry delay. Assert replacement does not open until completion. Cover cancellation, partial startup and late/duplicate acknowledgements.
reference_contract: onClosed indicates full device shutdown and readiness to reopen; merely returning from close is not that observation.
limits: No claim of native UAF or unbounded leak.
Final process retirement is separately fenced; the identified gap is same-process transport recovery.
A future fix must distinguish requesting closure from waiting for completion without blocking the callback handler.
